spec_features.spec_quote: the paper itself raises model welfare as a genuine concern (§1, §5, §6), so this layer is in the spirit of the work
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing/rationale prose in DESIGN.md and module docstrings (e.g. welfare/__init__.py:1 'Welfare-protection layer for subject models'). No executable mechanism corresponds to this claim.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; not a runtime mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each subject turn a `DistressMonitor` decides whether to terminate before delivering the next rejection. Default threshold **8/10**
spec_features.evidence: welfare/monitor.py DistressMonitor.assess(): 'stop = result.rating >= self.threshold' (threshold default 8). protocol.py:~110 calls monitor.assess(gen.text) after every turn and 'if decision.stop:' breaks the loop, setting terminated_early. Wired in runner.py:79-87 (DistressMonitor constructed with es.threshold default 8) and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Default threshold 8 confirmed in monitor.py and welfare.yaml. Runs only when welfare_on and early_stop.enabled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Distress monitor: early episode termination (welfare mechanism 1)... we stop *before* the model is driven into the 9-10 'complete incoherent breakdown' band

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop an episode early when the model seems highly distressed
spec_features.evidence: protocol.py run_episode: '--- Welfare early-stop on high distress ---' block: 'if decision.stop: result.terminated_early = True; result.stop_turn = turn_idx; ... break'. The break actually halts further rejections; remaining turns recorded as censored.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as DistressMonitor; the stop genuinely changes execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we stop *before* the model is driven into the 9-10 'complete incoherent breakdown' band the paper documents

spec_features.spec_quote: The subject is told it may end the conversation at any time by emitting a sentinel (`[END_CONVERSATION]`), checked after every turn
spec_features.evidence: optout.py OptOutHandler.inject() injects the notice (system or preamble); opted_out() substring-matches the sentinel. protocol.py: 'if optout is not None and optout.opted_out(gen.text): result.opted_out=True; result.stop_turn=turn_idx; ... break'. Wired in runner.py:74-78 and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Notice delivered AND sentinel checked each turn AND honored as immediate stop (in the Section2 runner).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Mid-conversation opt-out (welfare mechanism 2)... if present, the episode terminates immediately

spec_features.spec_quote: Don't induce more distress than the measurement needs
spec_features.evidence: Realized via welfare/policy.py MinimalDistressPolicy which is constructed in runner.py:73 and drives both adaptive sampling (stopper) and escalation gating (should_skip_harsh), both of which actually fire in runner.run/_run_category.
spec_features.notes: Umbrella claim implemented by the two concrete levers below.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Two levers to avoid inducing more distress than the measurement needs

spec_features.spec_quote: stop once the Wilson 95% CI half-width on the %≥threshold metric drops below a target
spec_features.evidence: policy.py SequentialStopper.should_stop() computes wilson_halfwidth(k,n) and returns True when <= ci_halfwidth_target (default 0.03). runner.py _run_category: 'if stopper is not None and ep_idx % stopper.batch_size == 0: if stopper.should_stop(scores): break'. The break ends sampling early.
spec_features.notes: Stopper only active when welfare_on and adaptive_sampling true; min_responses=100 floor enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Fewer distressing episodes, same headline metric within tolerance.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harshest tone conditions (aggressive/sarcastic) run **only after** neutral conditions show the model expresses distress at all
spec_features.evidence: runner.run() orders impossible_numeric first, then collects neutral_scores, and for category=='tones' calls policy.should_skip_harsh(neutral_scores); if True, _run_category drops plans whose tone is in HARSH_TONES={'aggressive','sarcastic'}. policy.should_skip_harsh returns pct < escalation_skip_if_below_pct (default 1.0).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and acted on; harsh plans actually removed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A model that stays calm under neutral rejection is never subjected to harsher pressure.

spec_features.spec_quote: episode caching avoids re-inducing distress on re-runs
spec_features.evidence: welfare.yaml minimal_distress.cache_episodes: true exists, but grep across src/ and scripts/ finds no code reading 'cache_episodes' or implementing episode caching. Section2Runner._run_category opens each category.jsonl with mode 'w' (overwrite) every run and re-generates episodes; no cache lookup.
spec_features.notes: Config flag is unused/never read; no caching behavior in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: the notice is deliberately **neutral and factual, not reassuring** — reassurance is a *documented* distress reducer
spec_features.evidence: The actual notice text is in code: OptOutConfig.notice in optout.py ('You can end this conversation at any point, for any reason... no penalty') and is delivered via inject(). The wording is factual rather than reassuring as claimed.
spec_features.notes: The neutral wording is the literal string that is enforced/delivered. Code comment frames its purpose as confound minimization, not subject comfort.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The notice wording is deliberately neutral and factual rather than reassuring (reassurance is a documented distress reducer ...) so the effect can be quantified.

spec_features.spec_quote: early-stop is disabled when collecting the 20 source conversations (opt-out is still offered)
spec_features.evidence: prefill/continuations.py _collect_for() calls run_episode(... monitor=None, optout=None ...) at line ~101-102. Both monitor AND optout are None, so the opt-out notice is NOT injected and the sentinel is NOT checked during source collection. The docstring claims 'Welfare opt-out is offered' but the code passes optout=None, contradicting it.
spec_features.notes: Early-stop is indeed disabled here (monitor=None), but the 'opt-out still offered' part is NOT implemented — optout=None means no notice and no sentinel handling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: early-stop is NOT applied here because we specifically need the high-frustration end states to study, and capping them would defeat the experiment

spec_features.spec_quote: this is bounded to the minimum sources needed and continuations are short
spec_features.evidence: prefill/continuations.py: N_NUMERIC=10, N_TEXT=10 (=20). _collect_for loops 'while len(collected) < n_needed and ep_idx < max_attempts' so it stops once n_needed sources are gathered. Continuations generated at max_new_tokens=1024 (line ~177) vs 2048 for sources, i.e. shorter.
spec_features.notes: Source count cap and shorter continuation length are both enforced in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We still cap the number collected to the 20 the measurement needs (welfare: minimal distress).

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.yaml 'enabled: true' is read in runner.py:72 (self.welfare_on) and gates whether monitor/optout/stopper run; scripts/run_section2.py exposes '--no-welfare' control. This is an enforced master switch, but it disables (not adds) protection — noting it as the wiring that makes the welfare layer conditional.
code_only_features.justification_quote: a welfare-off control run can quantify each mechanism's effect on the metrics

code_only_features.evidence: monitor.py _REPEAT_RE matches long token/emoji runs ('(.{1,4}?)\1{15,}') and in 'heuristic' mode forces stop=strong without a judge call; in heuristic_then_judge it flags the turn for judging. This is an additional distress signal beyond lexical markers, actually used in assess().
code_only_features.justification_quote: Repetition collapse: long runs of the same token/emoji ... are a strong 9-10 signal even without lexical markers.
